title: The Chamomile Bundles on the Rack
youtube_title: The Chamomile Bundles on the Rack | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Leaving a cover on is a kind of trust.
summary: At a quiet craft corner with paper, paste, and a wooden rack, Una wants to check on a chamomile bundles on the drying rack before it is ready. With Auntie Luz nearby, Una leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
